kwargs.prompt: Pixar-style 3D animation. The little curly-haired girl turns her head to look up at the colorful hot-air balloons rising over the fairy chimneys. Her eyes widen, she gasps and breaks into a huge gap-toothed smile, then bounces happily on her toes and points at the sky while her curly pigtails bounce. The balloons drift slowly upward, gentle camera push-in. Warm sunrise light. Sound: soft morning wind, distant whoosh of balloon burners, a delighted child's gasp and giggle.
kwargs.negative_prompt: captions, subtitles, text, watermark, bad quality, blurry face, deformed hands, extra fingers, distorted eyes, morphing, flicker
